fields.description: If enabled, creates an Employee Checkin with a blank employee link when the device PIN does not match any employee's Attendance Device ID
fields.label: Create Check-in for Unknown Employees

fields.description: When enabled, the server sends its configured timezone to the device on every handshake so the device clock stays in sync automatically. Disable if you prefer to set the timezone directly on the device hardware.
fields.label: Push Timezone to Device

fields.description: Commands older than this many days are automatically closed
fields.label: Force Close After (Days)
Delete Completed Commands After (Days)
fields.description: Successful and failed commands older than this are deleted daily in batches. Keeps the command table small, which is what the device-poll query reads on every poll.

fields.label: Suppress Identical Commands For (Minutes)
fields.description: An identical command (same device, user and type) raised again within this window is dropped. Guards against feedback loops where a device echoes a change back and re-triggers the push. 0 disables the guard.
Log all device communications to Attendance Device Log (for debugging). Disabled by default to avoid DB bloat.
fields.label: Enable Device Log
ZKTeco Sync Parameters
fields.description: These values are pushed to ZKTeco devices on every handshake. EBKN devices use real-time push and do not have a polling cycle — these settings do not apply to EBKN.
Seconds between device polls when idle (Delay= in handshake)
fields.label: Poll Delay (seconds)

fields.description: Seconds before retry after a communication error (ErrorDelay= in handshake)
fields.label: Error Delay (seconds)

fields.description: Semicolon-separated HH:MM times for scheduled batch uploads (TransTimes= in handshake)
fields.label: Upload Times

fields.description: Minutes between batch data uploads (TransInterval= in handshake)
fields.label: Upload Interval (minutes)

fields.description: A fingerprint template only matches on a device whose fingerprint algorithm version equals the version it was captured on. When enabled, Enroll User skips (does not push) any fingerprint whose algorithm version differs from the target device's version, and logs it — the user is still registered and can enrol the finger locally. Disable to push anyway (the device usually rejects the mismatched template with Return=-1).
fields.label: Enforce Fingerprint Version Match
Allow Check-in Corrections in Monitor
fields.description: When enabled, users with the required role can add/move/delete punches from the Attendance Monitor. Disable to make the monitor strictly view-only (some sites do not allow anyone, including HR, to modify raw check-ins).

fields.label: Attendance Processor (Server Script)
fields.description: OPTIONAL. A Server Script that (re)builds Attendance for one employee-day from raw Employee Checkins. When set, it runs after every check-in insert AND after Attendance Monitor corrections (add/edit/delete), so corrections stay in sync. Leave BLANK to rely on Frappe's native Shift Type auto-attendance instead. The script receives `doc` (an Employee Checkin carrying the employee + date to rebuild).
Configure your biometric devices to push data to these URLs
fields.label: Device Endpoint URLs

fields.description: Enter this as the Server Address in your ZKTeco device (ADMS / Cloud Server settings). When the HTTP listener is enabled, additional plain-HTTP addresses are shown.
fields.label: ZKTeco Server Address

fields.description: Enter this as the push server URL in your EBKN device settings. When the HTTP listener is enabled, plain-HTTP alternatives are shown.
fields.label: EBKN Server Address

fields.description: Copy this configuration block and paste it into your Nginx config, then run: sudo service nginx reload
fields.label: Generated Nginx Config

fields.description: Biometric devices use plain HTTP. If your Frappe server uses HTTPS (e.g. Frappe Cloud), devices need a local reverse proxy.
fields.label: On Premises HTTP Listener
